name: Wakabayashi Mie
source:
Mie is a loud, noisy and fussy girl. She has a sharp tongue and gets flustered easily. She is honest to herself and prone to argue. Also, she has developed very special feelings towards [url=https://vndb.org/c12868]Souji[/url] ever since she met him one day at a field close to a mountain near Tokiwa village.

Hobbies: Cooking, karate, taking care of her siblings
Favorite: Starting a fight (especially with [url=https://vndb.org/c3132]Sayaka[/url])
Behavior: Noisy, loud, and fussy. Another girl who talks without thinking but also gets embarrassed easily. She usually says whatever is on her mind in open rather than hiding it.

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=43]MangaGamer[/url] and [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/922090-suika-as/faqs/58095]neo-X-saga's Walkthrough[/url]]
